faqs.question: What types of artificial intelligence solutions do you build?
faqs.answer: We engineer three primary categories: 1) Autonomous agents and multilingual chatbots that interact with customers and trigger authorized database actions; 2) Enterprise RAG knowledge assistants that search and cite internal documents with zero hallucination; and 3) Intelligent document processing pipelines that extract and reconcile invoices, bills of lading, and contracts into your ERP.

faqs.question: Can AI connect to our CRM, ERP, database, or internal tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in building secure API connectors, webhooks, and database adapters for SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Odoo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and proprietary internal databases. The AI interacts with your existing systems securely using role-based permissions and audit logs.

faqs.question: Does our data need to be clean and organized before we start?
faqs.answer: No. Most enterprise data starts out messy, fragmented across PDFs, email threads, spreadsheets, and shared drives. During the initial audit phase, our engineers clean, deduplicate, and structure your data, creating the necessary embeddings and indexes for high-accuracy retrieval.

faqs.question: How do you reduce incorrect or unsupported AI answers?
faqs.answer: We employ a multi-layered guardrail architecture: strict Retrieval-Augmented Generation (forcing models to answer solely from retrieved context), semantic reranking to filter irrelevant text, system-level refusal rules when confidence thresholds are not met, deterministic JSON schema validation, and mandatory source citations.

faqs.question: Can it run in our own cloud or a private environment in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. For clients requiring strict data sovereignty—such as healthcare, banking, government, and legal organizations in the UAE—we deploy models within private VPCs in local AWS UAE / Microsoft Azure UAE regions, or directly on on-premises GPU infrastructure with zero data transmission to external third parties.

faqs.question: What is the average development time and cost structure?
faqs.answer: A focused, working proof-of-concept on your live operational data is typically delivered within 2 to 4 weeks. Full enterprise production deployment—including security audits, legacy system integration, staff training, and automated failover—generally takes 6 to 12 weeks with transparent milestone-based pricing.

faqs.question: Where are you based, and do you work with clients outside the UAE?
faqs.answer: DW Tech is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with technical delivery and engineering centers in Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), Milan (Italy), and Kerala (India). We serve enterprise clients across the UAE, the broader GCC, Europe, and North America.

faqs.question: Do you use the official WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: Yes. We exclusively implement the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. This ensures full compliance with WhatsApp terms of service, zero risk of account banning, and allows green-tick verified business badge verification.

faqs.question: Can the WhatsApp automation handle both Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our AI models are natively bilingual in Modern Standard Arabic, Gulf Arabic (Khaleeji), and English, understanding regional terminology, intent, and audio voice notes.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp automation integrate with our existing CRM or ERP?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build native webhooks and REST integrations connecting WhatsApp to Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or your custom ERP.

faqs.question: How does human agent handoff work?
faqs.answer: When a customer requests a live human, or when the AI detects a high-value sales opportunity, the conversation is seamlessly transferred to your sales or support agent with the full conversation history.
